comment: First runs on the primed-session cache scheme and the new default configuration: sonnet medium, 8 angles, 8 references, 12 test items, full resolution, seed 5. mix_8a8r draws test items and references across all three categories; obj_8a8r restricts both to objects. Cached mode: references are sent once per condition (the prime turn), every trial forks that session so the reference prefix is served from prompt cache.
